subject: Communication English
chapters: Chapter 3: Writing Technical Proposals & Project Reports

questions.text: Read the provided technical passage on "Artificial Intelligence in Structural Health Monitoring of Bridges and Infrastructure". Answer the comprehension questions, infer contextual meanings of technical terms, and write a concise summary (precis) in one-third of its original length.
Write a formal business letter of inquiry to a construction equipment manufacturer requesting a quotation, delivery schedule, and technical specifications for heavy-duty concrete batching plants.

Explain the standard structural components of a formal Engineering Feasibility Report (Letter of Transmittal, Title Page, Executive Summary, Table of Contents, Introduction, Methodology, Findings, Cost Analysis, Conclusions, Recommendations, and References).

questions.chapter: Chapter 3: Writing Technical Proposals & Project Reports
questions.text: Draft a formal Technical Project Proposal to the Department of Roads, Nepal, seeking funding for a feasibility study on "Solar-Powered Smart Traffic Signal Systems in Kathmandu Valley". Include Problem Statement, Objectives, Scope of Work, Methodology, Work Plan (Gantt Chart), Budget Estimate, and Expected Outcomes.

Explain the 7 Cs of effective professional communication (Clarity, Conciseness, Completeness, Correctness, Concreteness, Consideration, Courtesy). How do non-verbal cues (kinesics, proxemics, paralanguage) impact public technical presentations?
Prepare a professional Resume / Curriculum Vitae (CV) and a tailored Cover Letter applying for the post of Junior Structural Engineer / Software Engineer in a reputed multinational engineering firm.

Write an office memorandum (memo) from the Project Manager to all site engineers regarding strict adherence to occupational health and safety standards on a highway construction site. Also write professional meeting minutes for a project review meeting.
Rewrite the given non-technical and wordy sentences into concise, clear, and objective technical writing using appropriate passive constructions and nominalizations.
